name: Public S3 Bucket ACL
description: S3 bucket has a public ACL (public-read or public-read-write), exposing all objects to the internet without authentication.

name: Public S3 Bucket Policy
description: S3 bucket policy allows public access with Principal set to '*', making bucket data accessible to anyone on the internet.

name: S3 Versioning Disabled
description: S3 bucket does not have versioning enabled, preventing recovery from accidental deletion or overwrites.

name: S3 Server-Side Encryption Disabled
description: S3 bucket does not have server-side encryption configured, leaving data at rest unprotected.

name: S3 Access Logging Disabled
description: S3 bucket access logging is not enabled, making it impossible to audit who accessed bucket objects.

name: SSH Open to the World
description: Security group allows unrestricted inbound SSH access (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0, enabling brute-force attacks from any IP.

name: RDP Open to the World
description: Security group allows unrestricted inbound RDP access (port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing Windows instances to remote exploitation.

name: All Traffic Open to the World
description: Security group allows all inbound traffic (-1 protocol) from 0.0.0.0/0, completely exposing the resource to the internet.

name: HTTP Open to the World on Non-LB Resource
description: Security group allows unrestricted HTTP (port 80) traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on a non-load-balancer resource, increasing attack surface.

name: Wildcard Action in IAM Policy
description: IAM policy contains Action: '*', granting unlimited permissions and violating the principle of least privilege.

name: Wildcard Resource in IAM Policy
description: IAM policy targets Resource: '*', allowing actions on every resource in the account instead of specific ARNs.

name: Root Account Usage Detected
description: IAM policy or configuration references the root account (arn:aws:iam::*:root), which should never be used for routine operations.

name: MFA Not Required for Privileged Access
description: IAM policy allows privileged actions without requiring MFA, making account takeover easier if credentials are compromised.

name: Inline IAM Policy Used
description: Resource uses an inline IAM policy instead of a managed policy, making security reviews and bulk revocation difficult.

name: EBS Volume Not Encrypted
description: EBS volume has encryption disabled, leaving data at rest on disk unprotected if the physical media is compromised.

name: RDS Instance Encryption Disabled
description: RDS database instance does not have storage encryption enabled, exposing database data at rest to unauthorized access.

name: Secret or Password in Plaintext
description: Resource configuration contains a hardcoded password, secret key, or token in plaintext, which will be stored in IaC state files.

name: CloudTrail Not Enabled
description: No CloudTrail trail is configured for the region, meaning API calls and management events are not being audited.

name: VPC Flow Logs Disabled
description: VPC does not have Flow Logs enabled, making it impossible to audit network traffic for intrusion detection or forensics.

name: S3 Access Logging Not Configured
description: S3 bucket does not have server access logging enabled, leaving no audit trail of object-level GET and PUT operations.
